rationale: Asmita's deep expertise in LLM post-training and optimization pairs directly with Colin's conviction that engineered inference is the real competitive advantage in AI infrastructure — a natural alignment between cutting-edge model research and the GPU cloud infrastructure built to serve it. Colin's 20 years bridging developer needs with infrastructure, plus his hands-on experience with agentic AI tooling, could benefit from Asmita's research rigor in multimodal systems and responsible AI, while her work at NVIDIA and Cisco gives her the enterprise context Colin's ecosystem is increasingly touching.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Asmita Hajra — her post-training research at NVIDIA and deep technical understanding of LLM optimization aligns perfectly with your conviction that engineered inference is the real differentiator in AI infrastructure.
